claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve's PromptDatabase has prompt_history.jsonl, prompt_history_invalid.jsonl, deterministic seed and mutated prompt ids, template_sha256 identity, context-policy sha256 identity, append-only add/score/penalty events, prompt-history replay, parent lineage ids, duplicate-arm identity policy, UCB-style prompt-arm selection, prompt reward metadata, and optional meta-prompt template/context-policy mutation. It does not claim prompt-side archive retention policy, prompt descriptor/objective indexes, prompt archive-event streams, prompt migration/rebin semantics, prompt async/controller resume state, or prompt-database benchmark evidence.
source_claim: AlphaEvolve co-evolves prompt instructions in a separate database analogous to the solution-program database; local prompt storage must not be described as equivalent without archive lifecycle and benchmark evidence
